name: occurrence_only
notes: true only when semantic_equivalent is true and occurrence_only_artifacts is non-empty

name: raw_byte_equivalent
notes: byte identity of compared artifact bytes

name: semantic_equivalent
notes: match after occurrence-only fields are removed; result key equivalent aliases it

name: NOT_EQUIVALENT
notes: no identifier; mismatch is semantic_equivalent false or mismatched_artifacts

name: OCCURRENCE_ONLY_DIFFERENT
notes: not an identifier; nearest key is occurrence_only

name: SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENT
notes: not an identifier; nearest key is semantic_equivalent

name: manifest_id
notes: dataset field and artifact comparison union

name: run_id
notes: dataset field and artifact comparison union

name: rebuild_only
notes: default when the snapshot envelope is incomplete and resume was not requested

name: resume_only
notes: resume requested without a full snapshot envelope
